description: U.S. care locations only. Do not call for care outside the United States or substitute U.S. national prices; explain the coverage limit. A user anywhere may ask for U.S. care prices. Explain the returned source labels, counts, confidence, and caveats for one entity. Report available_price_count separately from unavailable placeholders; price_count includes both. Describe only source_summary categories actually returned. If available_price_count is zero, say no current source-labeled price is available, without adding generic source categories or prices.

cpt_codes.description: Optional CPT codes to explain. If omitted, explains current indexed prices.

limit.description: Maximum number of prices to inspect, default 50, max 100.

slug.description: Exact Loa entity slug from search_entities.

name: explain_price_sources

available_price_count.description: Rows with a usable price; excludes unavailable placeholders.

price_count.description: Total resolver rows, including unavailable placeholders.

source_url.description: Supporting source link. A CMS Hospital Price Transparency policy page is not the hospital source file; do not attribute hospital-published prices to CMS.

unavailable_price_count.description: Rows without a usable price; not evidence of a published or verified price.

title: Explain Price Sources
